name: phase5-capacity-performance

dataset.insertion_order: start, outputs, review, correction referencing the stored review, completion
dataset.timestamps: fixed valid UTC timestamps increasing with event index
dataset.identifiers: run-specific prefix and zero-padded interaction/event indices; all IDs at most 64 characters
dataset.data: synthetic fixed-size reference/review payloads; no credentials or real interaction content

workload.definition: ordinary retrieval requests from AC-10; excludes setup, reset, loading, health and tester control operations
workload.selection: fixed queue; five rounds of both operations for every interaction; at most ten in flight; all 1000 scheduled requests remain in the denominator
workload.warmup: explicit unscored readiness and dataset verification after loading; retain its observations separately
workload.response_cache: no application response-cache substitution; ordinary PostgreSQL/OS cache behavior retained and documented

measurement.primary: monotonic application response-ready duration per timed request
measurement.boundary: ASGI HTTP application entry to response-start, after a buffered route has produced/serialized its response
includes: required PostgreSQL access including dependency I/O
measurement.secondary: separate client end-to-end monotonic duration, including external network delay
measurement.missing_invalid_or_negative_server_metri: measurement_incomplete; never estimate network delay or claim network-excluded acceptance
measurement.percentiles: nearest-rank over all timed requests with valid measurements; report p50, p95, p99 and max plus exact fast-success count
measurement.correctness: zero lost/changed seed records and zero unexpected HTTP/schema/content errors; at least 950 of the 1000 requests both correct and at most 1.0 second

isolation.default_environment: dedicated disposable local PostgreSQL database and separate app process
isolation.deployed_run_gate: arrange a separate benchmark database/deployment or an explicitly approved exclusive test window with a recovery/export plan; retain baseline and target revision before/after
isolation.peer_load_gate: agree workload/timing semantics and obtain explicit owner authorization for load/reset; prior functional cross-tests do not authorize new load tests

required_evidence: database/deployment resources, pool settings and topology without secrets
warmup observations and whether dataset starts empty
verified seed manifest and counts before/after
all 1000 request outcomes and both timing series
unexpected responses, timeouts and missing metrics without raw tokens/payloads
fast-success numerator/denominator, latency summaries and correctness results
separate capacity verdict, timing-measurement completeness and performance verdict
not_claimed: peer approval of the proposed request mix
